description: Single and two storey rear extension; Rear dormer; Installation of roof lights in side roof slopes; External alterations; Patio to rear; Replacement raised swimming pool and patio to rear;  Landscaping to rear; Single storey detached outbuilding at rear for use as Hobby room/Store; Brick wall piers, railings and gates to front (Demolition of outbuilding to rear)
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed front boundary railings, together with the brick wall piers and sliding entrance gate, by reason of materials and height, appears as an incongruous, and visually obtrusive addition to the street scene given its prominent position on Eastcote Road. The proposal also conflicts with the prevailing pattern of development and is therefore contrary to the high-quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), and D3 of The London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan 2021-2041.</p>

<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The proposed
development is located within surface water flood zones high and medium and
fluvial flood zone 2 (medium) and 3 (high). In the absence of a satisfactory
Flood Risk Assessment, it has not been demonstrated that the proposed
development would not exacerbate the risk of flooding within the site or
increase the risk and consequences of flooding elsewhere, contrary to National
Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy SI 12 of The London Plan (2021), and
Policies CN3 and CN4 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</span></p>
